description: This file defines the server-side logic for the 'Logout' page in the Identity area of an ASP.NET Core web application. It handles user sign-out, cache management, and redirection after logout.

classes.name: LogoutModel
classes.description: Razor Page model dedicated to handling user logout process, including sign-out from services, cache updates, and redirection.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: GET handler for the logout page, intentionally left empty to handle GET requests.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: POST handler that performs user sign-out, cache update with user claims, logs the logout event, and redirects to the specified return URL or the index page.
